key_path: Sign up at auth0.com/signup (Google/GitHub/Microsoft social or email; email verification for password signups); a tenant is auto-created
`auth0 login` (Auth0 CLI device authorization flow: confirm a code in the browser) OR `npx @auth0/auth0-mcp-server init` (same device flow, token stored in the OS keychain)
For app credentials: `auth0 apps create` / `auth0 quickstarts` produce client id/secret; for Management API, create an M2M app + client_credentials grant

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes: `auth0 login` uses the device flow, or `--client-id/--client-secret` for M2M
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: Auth0's own MCP is local (device-flow token), not remote OAuth. As an enabler, Auth0 sells DCR for MCP clients (Auth for MCP)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes: Management API creates apps/clients/grants; M2M client credentials
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes: Management API scopes per M2M grant; MCP server `--read-only` and `--tools` globs

mcp.local: npx @auth0/auth0-mcp-server init [--client claude-code|cursor|vscode|windsurf|gemini] [--read-only] [--tools 'auth0_list_*']. stdio; Beta per the README
mcp.docs_mcp: none found; Auth0 agent-skills repo for Claude Code instead
mcp.one_click: `init --client X` writes the client config; no remote URL deeplinks

docs_for_agents.md_pages: yes: docs .md plus marketing pages as .md (e.g. /ai.md)
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: Agent Experience Score https://auth0.com/agent-experience.md (8 models x 15 frameworks, 87% without vs 98% with Auth0 tools)

score_justification: Device-flow CLI and MCP init are agent-friendly and the docs are excellent, but there's no remote OAuth MCP and no keyless path. The MCP is still Beta and local-only.
best_practice: Publishes a measured Agent Experience Score (how well models integrate Auth0 with and without its tools). The MCP init takes `--read-only` and tool-glob scoping.
biggest_gap: No hosted remote MCP, and getting management credentials means creating an M2M app
notes: docs path /docs/customize/integrations/ai-tools/auth0-mcp-server from llms.txt returned 404 (stale link); the README points to /docs/get-started/mcp.
enabler_features: Auth for MCP: authorize your MCP server, Dynamic Client Registration, FGA for MCP tools, Cloudflare MCP guide
Token Vault: agents call third-party APIs on a user's behalf without seeing credentials
CIBA asynchronous authorization (human-in-the-loop approvals via push/SMS/email)
Agent as Principal: register agents as first-class identities, agent_id in tokens and tenant logs
Cross App Access (XAA) / MCP Enterprise-Managed Authorization (ID-JAG)
